pointsOfInterest.name: Mos Eisley Spaceport
pointsOfInterest.description: A wretched hive of scum and villainy. The main spaceport on Tatooine, filled with cantinas, markets, and all manner of shady characters.

pointsOfInterest.name: Jabba's Palace
pointsOfInterest.description: The former stronghold of Jabba the Hutt. Now abandoned but still dangerous, filled with traps and potential treasure.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Lars Homestead
pointsOfInterest.description: The abandoned moisture farm where Luke Skywalker grew up. A place of historical significance, now empty but holding secrets.

pointsOfInterest.name: Beggar's Canyon
pointsOfInterest.description: A treacherous canyon system where legendary swoop bike races are held. Home to dangerous creatures and hidden dangers.

pointsOfInterest.name: Jundland Wastes
pointsOfInterest.description: The vast desert wasteland of Tatooine, home to krayt dragons, Tusken Raiders, and other dangers.

pointsOfInterest.name: Mos Eisley Cantina
pointsOfInterest.description: The famous cantina where deals are made and information is traded. A hub for smugglers and bounty hunters.
